news.title: Source: Elastic agrees to buy CRV-backed DeductiveAI for up to $85M
news.description: DeductiveAI, a startup that uses AI to catch and resolve bugs in software, was founded just three years ago.

news.title: AI inference startup Baseten reportedly raising $1.5B months after its last mega-round
news.description: Startup Baseten is reportedly close to finalizing a $1.5 billion round at a $13 billion as the “inference gold rush" marches on.

news.title: Snap spins off AI video team into new company, Dotmo, due to costs
news.description: The Snapchat maker is spinning off yet another internal unit. Dotmo will be composed of current Snap staff who are leaving the social media company to focus on AI video development.

news.title: OpenAI is bringing on some big guns in the lead-up to its IPO
news.description: OpenAI is bulking up before its IPO, landing Transformer co-inventor Noam Shazeer from Google DeepMind and former Trump AI policy official Dean Ball in the same week.

news.title: UK AI regulator quits after 'attempts at humour that were inappropriate'
news.description: Edwards has been the boss of the data watchdog since January 2022, and said he had made inappropriate attempts at humour.

news.title: The artificial ice pyramids saving India's mountain villages
news.description: Himalayan villages are creating artificial glaciers to guarantee water for their crops in the spring.

news.title: AI will create more jobs for humans, not replace them, Amazon founder Bezos says
news.description: The Amazon founder, who now has robotics and space travel companies, thinks AI will create a labour shortage.

news.title: What to study in the AI age - from big tech bosses
news.description: Sundar Pichai, Jensen Huang and Jack Clark share their advice with the BBC.
